identifierPolicy.newIdentifiers: UUIDv7 generated by the runtime that creates the record
identifierPolicy.legacyIdentifiers: Existing UUIDv4 publicId values remain valid and immutable
identifierPolicy.publicReferences: Only stable IDs cross process or repository boundaries; database surrogate keys never do

local_private.meaning: The record stays on one native installation unless the user explicitly promotes it

cloud_synced.meaning: One account owns the cloud record and native clients keep offline replicas

collaborative_shared.meaning: The cloud owns accepted shared state and authorized clients keep replicas

scopeTransitions.rule: Subject to entity scopeConstraints, an allowed transition is an explicit atomic aggregate operation that preserves IDs and applies every relationship scopeChangeAction; a forbidden transition requires a new local-private copy with a new ID

identity.rule: Set by the creating authority and immutable after first acknowledgement

ownership.rule: Exactly one principal owns a record; collaboration grants access without creating another owner

scope_transition.rule: The creating Local Engine chooses local_private; promotion or later Cloud scope changes require an explicit atomic aggregate transition

domain_content.rule: The canonical store owns accepted content; a native client may hold unacknowledged edits

lifecycle.rule: The canonical store assigns accepted versions, hashes, timestamps, tombstones, and restorations

attribution.rule: The canonical store validates the acting principal before accepting the value

locator.rule: Each storage runtime owns its private locator; locators are never synchronized as domain content

stable_id.postgresql: uuid (varchar(36) is a supported transition for existing publicId columns)

instant.postgresql: timestamp with time zone normalized to UTC
instant.sqlite: INTEGER microseconds since Unix epoch UTC

sha256.postgresql: char(64) lowercase hexadecimal with format CHECK
sha256.sqlite: TEXT lowercase hexadecimal with length and format CHECK

short_text.postgresql: varchar with the field constraint's maximum length
short_text.sqlite: TEXT with the field constraint's maximum length CHECK

decimal.postgresql: numeric with the field's required precision and scale
decimal.sqlite: TEXT in canonical decimal form with precision and scale checks
decimal.wireFormat: JSON string: optional minus, canonical integer part, optional fractional part without trailing zero; no plus sign, exponent, leading zero, negative zero, or decimal point on an integer

json.sqlite: TEXT containing canonical JSON and guarded by json_valid

enum.sqlite: TEXT with the same CHECK constraint

syncEnvelope.name: ownerId
syncEnvelope.description: The record's single logical owner principal

syncEnvelope.name: replicationScope
syncEnvelope.description: Replication authority mode, not a publication ACL

syncEnvelope.name: schemaVersion
syncEnvelope.description: Version of this entity's canonical payload shape

syncEnvelope.name: version
syncEnvelope.description: Monotonic accepted mutation version, including delete and restore

syncEnvelope.name: contentHash
syncEnvelope.description: SHA-256 of canonical domain content, never of replica metadata

syncEnvelope.name: updatedAt
syncEnvelope.description: Canonical time of the accepted version

syncEnvelope.name: deletedAt
syncEnvelope.description: Nullable tombstone marker; a value means the record is logically deleted

syncEnvelope.name: deletedById
syncEnvelope.description: Principal that created the current tombstone

paperItem.description: Stable ordered membership of a question or immutable question snapshot in a paper

commentAnchor.description: Optional stable pointer into a draft, paper item, or question field

entities.name: paper
entities.description: An ordered assessment paper with stable paper-item identities

fields.name: items
constraints: array of paperItem; item IDs and order values are unique
questionSnapshot is required and authoritative; optional questionId is provenance only

entities.name: draft
entities.description: Mutable workspace state that may be private, synchronized, or collaborative

entities.name: attachment
entities.description: Versioned attachment metadata that references an immutable content-addressed blob

fields.name: mediaType
constraints: 1..255 characters; registered or vendor media type

fields.name: blobHash
fields.description: Hash of raw bytes; distinct from the metadata contentHash

entities.name: comment
entities.description: A review or collaboration comment owned by its author

entities.name: favorite
entities.description: A user's durable membership marker for a favoritable target

entities.name: setting
entities.description: A namespaced per-device or per-account preference

relationships.name: paper_item_question
relationships.existence: questionId is optional provenance; when present it must resolve when the item is created or imported
relationships.ownerCompatibility: same owner or source readable by the paper owner at snapshot time
relationships.scopeCompatibility: source question may be in the same scope or a scope readable by the paper owner
relationships.onTargetTombstone: retain questionSnapshot and questionId as provenance; never cascade or rewrite the paper
relationships.onTargetRestore: no paper mutation; provenance resolves live again
relationships.postgresqlEnforcement: application authorization plus stable-ID lookup; paper item snapshot remains self-contained
relationships.sqliteEnforcement: application validation; snapshot is required so offline reads never require the referenced question
relationships.onTargetOwnerTransfer: retain the immutable paper snapshot and provenance without changing paper ownership
relationships.onTargetScopeChange: retain the immutable paper snapshot and provenance without changing paper scope

relationships.name: draft_paper
relationships.existence: optional; when present it must resolve at draft creation or import and draft.state remains self-contained
relationships.ownerCompatibility: same owner or paper readable by the draft owner at snapshot time
relationships.scopeCompatibility: referenced paper must be readable in the draft scope
relationships.onTargetTombstone: retain the stable reference and self-contained draft state; never cascade
relationships.onTargetRestore: no draft mutation; provenance resolves live again
relationships.postgresqlEnforcement: nullable stable-ID foreign-key mapping when concrete, plus application authorization
relationships.sqliteEnforcement: nullable deferred foreign key when the paper replica exists, plus application validation for imported snapshots
relationships.onTargetOwnerTransfer: retain the self-contained draft state and provenance without changing draft ownership
relationships.onTargetScopeChange: retain the self-contained draft state and provenance without changing draft scope

relationships.name: attachment_target
relationships.existence: exactly one live target is required when attachment metadata is created
relationships.onTargetTombstone: atomically create a newer tombstone for every live attachment targeting the entity; blob bytes remain reference-counted
relationships.onTargetRestore: do not restore attachments implicitly; an authorized explicit restore chooses attachment versions
relationships.postgresqlEnforcement: typed target link tables or equivalent constraint triggers plus one service transaction
relationships.sqliteEnforcement: typed target link tables with foreign keys/triggers plus one Local Engine transaction
relationships.onTargetOwnerTransfer: atomically assign the target's new ownerId to every attachment; reject the target transfer if any attachment cannot transition
relationships.onTargetScopeChange: atomically promote or change every attachment and required blob; reject the target transition if any attachment cannot transition

relationships.name: comment_target
relationships.existence: exactly one live and readable target is required when a comment is created
relationships.ownerCompatibility: comment owner is its author and need not equal target owner; author must have target access
relationships.scopeCompatibility: comment scope must be cloud_synced or collaborative_shared and cannot be broader than target access
relationships.onTargetTombstone: atomically create newer tombstones for target comments and their descendants
relationships.postgresqlEnforcement: typed target link tables or equivalent constraint triggers plus authorization in one service transaction
relationships.sqliteEnforcement: foreign keys/triggers for cached typed links; Cloud remains canonical
relationships.onTargetOwnerTransfer: comment authors remain owners; revalidate access without rewriting accepted comment history
relationships.onTargetScopeChange: atomically change the scope of target comments and descendants; reject the target transition if any comment cannot transition

relationships.name: comment_parent
relationships.existence: optional; parent must be live when a reply is created
relationships.ownerCompatibility: reply owner is its own author; parent ownership is independent
relationships.scopeCompatibility: parent and reply must have identical targetType, targetId, and replicationScope
relationships.onTargetTombstone: atomically tombstone every live descendant in the thread
relationships.postgresqlEnforcement: self foreign key plus same-target constraint trigger/application invariant
relationships.sqliteEnforcement: self foreign key plus trigger/application invariant
relationships.onTargetOwnerTransfer: comment ownership is immutable; reject any attempted parent-comment ownership transfer
relationships.onTargetScopeChange: atomically apply the same scope to every descendant in the thread

relationships.name: favorite_target
relationships.existence: target must be live and readable when the favorite is created or restored
relationships.ownerCompatibility: favorite owner is the acting user and need not equal target owner
relationships.scopeCompatibility: target must be cloud_synced or collaborative_shared; favorite itself is cloud_synced
relationships.onTargetTombstone: atomically create a newer favorite tombstone
relationships.onTargetRestore: do not recreate the favorite implicitly
relationships.postgresqlEnforcement: typed target link tables or equivalent constraint trigger plus one service transaction
relationships.sqliteEnforcement: cached typed links validated against the replica; Cloud remains canonical
relationships.onTargetOwnerTransfer: favorite owner remains unchanged; tombstone the favorite if the owner loses target access
relationships.onTargetScopeChange: favorite remains cloud_synced while its target remains cloud_synced or collaborative_shared

lifecycleInvariants.update: An accepted semantic mutation increments version, recomputes contentHash, and advances updatedAt atomically
lifecycleInvariants.delete: Deletion creates a newer tombstone by setting deletedAt and deletedById; it never reuses or changes id
lifecycleInvariants.restore: Restore clears deletedAt and deletedById on a newer version of the same id
lifecycleInvariants.history: Every accepted version is append-only history; redaction is a separately audited exceptional operation
lifecycleInvariants.purge: Physical purge and blob garbage-collection retention are policy decisions deferred to their implementing issues
lifecycleInvariants.conflictBoundary: A mutation whose base version or base hash is stale must never silently overwrite accepted state; both candidates remain recoverable
lifecycleInvariants.protocolDeferral: Cursors, operation IDs, acknowledgements, retries, batching, wire errors, and merge algorithms are defined by CLE-29

hashPolicy.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, canonical numbers, and array order preserved
hashPolicy.payload: entity name, schemaVersion, and every effective field marked hash=include

implementationBoundaries.cloudMigrations: Future Alembic revisions project this logical contract into PostgreSQL; this contract does not expose SQLAlchemy models
implementationBoundaries.localMigrations: CLE-25 and CLE-36 project the same logical contract into Desktop and Mobile SQLite without importing cloud migrations
implementationBoundaries.syncProtocol: CLE-29 defines transport and convergence behavior while preserving these identity, lifecycle, and conflict invariants
implementationBoundaries.sharedLibraryAcl: CLE-19 defines private/team/public publication and roles; replicationScope is not an ACL
